checks.name: all existing deployed game definitions and identities stay unchanged
actual retained handler requires exact model identity before touching funds
actual retained spin transaction replays one canonical receipt after reply loss
actual retained replay-only spin never creates an unreceived wager
actual retained debit/credit/commit fault paths roll back the entire wager
actual retained restrictions reject session, active game, house capacity and account cap
actual retained gamble requires expected state and replays without another stake
actual retained state supplies the new model version and latest authoritative gamble amount
actual retained receipt binds its math model and prevents cross-action token reuse

scope: Actual retrieved core, fresh-release hooks, settlement, action and transaction source executed against a disposable in-memory SQL fixture.
limitation: The fixture validates source control flow and rollback intent. It does not verify PostgreSQL row-lock concurrency, schema constraints, triggers or authenticated gateway integration.
